note: 22 Sept 2026 - 'The Secret They Never Taught You About Getting Rich' (Rumble v78i2g6), podcast panel. Month plan, money lane.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's friend taught seminars on this exact subject. He still had a habit he never noticed.

Every time he looked at a deal, he said the same thing: "I have a concern." Concern means fear. And his deals kept going sideways.

Kevin told him to say "I have a question" instead. Or better: "There's something here I think we can make better."

Three weeks later he signed a $10 million deal.

#kevintrudeau #negotiation #words #business #deals #wealthmindset

Do you see yourself as someone who deserves money?

Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people hold three beliefs so deep they are facts to them. Money is good. Money is safe to have. And I am the right person to have it, because I will do good with it - like Andrew Carnegie building thousands of libraries.

People who struggle with money carry the opposite, usually without knowing it.

Which of the three is hardest for you?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #selfimage #wealth #yourwishisyourcommand #success

Tell people you're starting a business and becoming a millionaire. They'll say good for you.

Kevin Trudeau says underneath, most of them hope you crash. Everybody wants you to do well - just not that well.

So he tells no one. The Rolls-Royce shows up and his friends say you never told me. No, he didn't.

Keep your dreams to yourself.

#kevintrudeau #goals #success #mindset #millionairemindset #privacy

The universe doesn't do things to us. It does things for us.

John D. Rockefeller said that after giving, the thing that built his wealth most was finding the seed of a greater benefit in every adversity.

Watch the stories of the people who built America: the factory burns down, there's no money left - and that's when the idea comes that makes them rich.

Kevin Trudeau calls himself a gold digger. Every disaster has gold in it.

#kevintrudeau #rockefeller #adversity #wealth #resilience #success

Sit at home grateful and appreciative and do nothing, and you won't make any money. Work hard with a lousy attitude, and you won't either.

Kevin Trudeau's ski trip: his friends leapt out of bed at 4am to hit the slopes. He stayed in bed. On a fishing trip it was the reverse.

When you love the goal, you can't stop taking action - and the action stops feeling like work.

The journey is the reward.

#kevintrudeau #positivethinking #action #motivation #success #mindset

Stop telling your story.

Kevin Trudeau says every story of woe sounds the same: they did this to me, they betrayed me, they cheated me.

In every one of those stories there is one common denominator. You were there.

Work on yourself instead of waiting for other people to change - and watch how fast people stop stabbing you in the back.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #accountability #personalgrowth #success #selfimprovement

You are being programmed every single day. Screens on the plane you can't turn off. Screens in every airport. Nonstop advertising.

Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people fight back on purpose. Leaders are readers - even five minutes a day of a positive book. And audios of people who overcame adversity.

Successful people aren't people without problems. They're people who keep getting back up.

#kevintrudeau #reading #mindset #programming #success #habits
